# GAOS v1.0.4 — replaceable experience providers

This compatible patch adds `@yugao-gaos/gaos-sdk/experience-providers`, a
product-neutral contract for selecting and replacing reasoning, speech
recognition, speech synthesis, live-world, and replay-video providers.

Provider profiles describe ordered product policy without owning credentials,
network routing, prompts, UI, or storage. The v1.0.2 adaptive speech boundary
surface and all v1 room-agent APIs remain included and unchanged.

Existing v1.0 callers require no changes.
